text:
maria_sales: FYI — BankAML contacted us for a POC. They need a simple dataflow diagram showing: where customer data lands, which subprocessors touch tokens, and proof that EU data stays in eu-west-1. Also they want KMS key-wrapping details. Timeline: need something by EOD Wed. Can we assemble?

alex_se: Got it. I'll draft a minimal dataflow + subproc list tonight. Do we have an existing EU hosting artifact we can adapt? See drive template link.

sam_design: I can do the diagram. Using the 'POC-dataflow-template-v2' in Drive. I'll avoid IPs and put component names only. Anyone want to review security wording?

nick_security: +1. We'll need to redact internal hostnames and only list subprocessor company names and services. For KMS: we can confirm we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments and BYOK options; for Hosted we use Redwood KMS with HSM-backed keys — we can provide KMS architecture note. Also note: we can't provide raw access logs without a contract. :shield:

lisa_legal: Add "No production data stored during POC unless agreed" and include our standard DPA excerpt. If they require SOC2/ISO artifacts, route via sales->legal for evidence handoff. Also request a signed NDA if they're asking for detailed network diagrams.

alex_se: Drafted subproc list (local copy):
```
- Cloud provider: AWS (eu-west-1)
- Object storage: S3 (managed by Redwood)
- Logging/observability: Datadog (no raw payload retention)
- Key management: AWS KMS (Redwood-managed) / BYOK option for Private
- Model serving infra: Redwood Dedicated (partner infra)
```

sam_design: Uploaded diagram (link): https://redwood.app/drive/poc/183123-diagram.png — using component labels only.

maria_sales: Thanks team. I'll send this to BankAML contact (olivia_b@bankex) with a note about NDA and DPA attachments. Target: send by 2025-06-04 EOD. :pray:

bank_poc: Thanks, this looks good. Quick Q: can you confirm that embeddings and logs for POC will stay in eu-west-1? Also request sample KMS policy snippet.

nick_security: Confirmed: for Hosted POC we persist embeddings in eu-west-1; logs are aggregated but stored in the same region for retention period. I'll paste a short KMS policy snippet in next reply.

nick_security: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"Service":"redwood-inference.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"kms:Encrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-efgh"}
  ]
}
```

lisa_legal: Uploaded DPA excerpt: https://redwood.app/legal/dpa/standard-dpa-v3.pdf

maria_sales: I'll loop in legal if they push for SOC2 evidence. For now I'll send diagram + subproc list + DPA link and ask for NDA. :+1:

bank_poc: great, sending NDA now. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
